description:
The Freego Nova 3 is a high-end electric bike equipped with a powerful 3000W mid-drive motor, dual-piston hydraulic brakes, and a 220mm disc rotor for enhanced safety and durability. With exceptional performance, it reaches a top speed of 40 mph and has a load capacity of 264 lbs.

Mode Freego Nova 3

Max Speed 40mph (64km/h) Varies depending upon load and road condition. 5 Speed levels available. Speed 1: 10MPH, Speed 5: 40MPH

Motor Power Output 1000 Watts (nominal), 3000Watts (peak) Mid drive Brushless Motor (DC)

Battery 60V, 25Ah(1500Wh) with 80 Lithium Battery cells (27100 type)

Charging Time 5-8 H

Riding Range Eco mode (at 10mph): 50 miles Sports mode (at 40mph): 20 miles

Controller Brushless Motor Controller 80A/260A

Motor Activation Conditions/Modes Triggered by either an electric throttle only

Throttle Type Half-Twist

Frame Material High-strength Steel Pipe

Max Loading 264 lbs (120kg)

Net Weight 117 lbs (53kg) including battery (battery 20 lbs)

Package Size 59*11.8*32 inch (150*30*83cm)

Transmission Gears This transmission system achieves a 1:9.6 reduction ratio via two-stage speed reduction. The first stage uses a pulley (23:51 ratio), and the second uses a chain sprocket (13:56 ratio).

Brake System Hydraulic Disc Brake on Front and rear wheels. 2- piston hydraulic disc brakes + 220mm disc rotors

Suspension High-Performance Hydraulic Front & Rear Shock Absorbers

Light LED headlight & rear brake light

Suggested Rider Height 4'8"-6'1" (144-186cm)

Wheel Type & Size Spoke Wheels, Front/Rear 17 x 1.4 Alloy Rims

Tire Size Fat tire 80/100 - 17(3.15×17 inches) for both wheels

Tire Types Tubed, pneumatic motorcycle-grade tires, puncture-resistant

Affordable Mid-Drive Performance For Everyday Adventure

The Freego Nova 3 is designed for riders looking for an affordable mid-drive electric dirt bike with strong off-road capability and everyday versatility. Its centrally mounted motor delivers improved balance, climbing performance, and efficient power delivery compared with traditional hub-motor electric bikes.

Whether you're exploring trails, gravel roads, or recreational off-road terrain, the Nova 3 provides a practical entry point into the world of electric motos and dirt-style electric bikes.

Affordable mid-drive electric dirt bike

Ideal for riders entering the electric moto category

Built for trail riding and off-road exploration

Excellent balance of power, range, and value

Why Choose A Mid-Drive Electric Dirt Bike?

Mid-drive systems place the motor in the center of the frame, improving weight distribution, climbing performance, and overall handling. Riders who frequently ride hills, trails, and rough terrain often prefer mid-drive electric dirt bikes because they deliver more responsive power and greater efficiency.
